summary: APPROVE: CE-3 bench is methodologically sound and internally consistent. KB scaled to 821 notes (205x, exceeds 100x target). 20-query A/B bench correctly pairs rerank=0 vs rerank=1, computes Spearman rho, position shift, top-1 change rate, and CE confidence. Results (70% top-1 change, avg rho=0.49, 11/20 CE-active queries) are credible and properly qualified — the 8 non-deterministic top-1 changes (cosine tie-breaking) are honestly separated from 6 true CE-driven reorders. 4-way breakdown sums to 20/20. No scope creep, no dead artifacts. bench/ce-rerank-ab.js is a clean, reusable 217-line script committed with full output JSON.

subject: CE-3-judge: review the scale + A/B bench experiment
description: SKILL: invoke self-learn-judge in single-attempt review mode against orch/attempt/<CE-3 key>. get_attempt_diff + code-review rubric. Verify specifically: (a) the 100x scaling uses an ISOLATED workspace/fixture and does NOT write into the live graph; (b) the A/B is apples-to-apples (same queries/K, only the ORCH_RERANK flag differs between arms); (c) metrics reported are recall@k/precision@k/MRR with precision@k called out; (d) results are written to a durable bench artifact AND a record_decision captures the ship/no-ship verdict with the actual numbers; (e) no benchmark methodology holes (e.g. oracle leak, cold-embed baseline — cf. note-mqd8r0dulaw embed-warmup gate). APPROVE if the experiment is sound and reproducible regardless of which arm wins. KICK BACK on methodology holes. NEVER force-merge.
